events.title: 2026 Glendive Turkey Trot 5k
events.description:
Start your holiday with a healthy tradition before the big feast! Join us for the 2026 Glendive Turkey Trot 5K on Thanksgiving morning, November 26th at Makoshika Wellness (111 W. Bell, Studio Side).

📅 Race Day Details: ✨ Check-in, shirt pickup & last-minute registration ($35) → 8:00–8:45 AM ✨ Run kicks off → 9:00 AM ✨ Bring 2 non-perishable food items to support the Dawson County Food Bank 🥫❤️

🎽 Shirt Deadline: Sign up by November 12th to guarantee your event shirt on race day!

All proceeds benefit Makoshika Wellness and the Dawson County Food Bank.

👉 Register online or grab a form at Squad Sports or Makoshika Wellness.

The route- https://www.plotaroute.com/route/1737602?units=km

The Facebook event- https://www.facebook.com/share/1S45U7G5fz/

events.title: Richland Ranger Turkey Trot
events.description:
🦃🏃‍♀️ 3rd Annual Richland Ranger Turkey Trot! 🏃‍♂️🦃

It’s that time of year again… time to run before you eat! 😂

Join the Richland Rangers Hockey Team for our 3rd Annual Turkey Trot, where we combine two of America’s favorite Thanksgiving traditions: eating way too much and pretending running will make up for it. 🍗🥧

Whether you’re a serious runner, a casual walker, or someone whose only goal is to make it to the finish line without pulling a hamstring—we want YOU there!

And the best part? Your participation helps give back to our community! ❤️

💰 Proceeds from the Turkey Trot will benefit: 🥫 Richland County Food Bank 🏒 Richland Youth Hockey Association

So lace up those shoes, grab your family and friends, and come burn a few calories before you replace them with turkey, stuffing and pie!

Come run. Come walk. Come have fun. Come hungry. 😂

Because nothing says Thanksgiving like running for a good cause so you can feel slightly less guilty about that second piece of pie. 🥧🤣

Gobble Gobble! We’ll see you at the starting line!

Food Donations will also be accepted the day of the race!

Register by end of day November 14th to guarantee your race day t-shirt. Sign ups after November 14th do not guarantee a shirt.

This Turkey Trot is the perfect guilt-free solution for eating your weight in mashed potatoes.

Start Time:

5K - 9:00am

1 Mile Little Drumstick Run - 9:00am

Start and Finish:

The start and finish lines will be in the same location at Richland Youth Hockey arena

events.title: Bold St. Nick'S Fatbike Race
events.description:
BE BOLD, BRAVE THE COLD AT THE 11th ANNUAL WINTER FATBIKE RACE IN THE NORTH DAKOTA BADLANDS. WHETHER YOU’RE ON BOLD ST. NICK’S NAUGHTY LIST OR NICE LIST, YOU WILL EXPERIENCE THE WORLD-FAMOUS MAAH DAAH HEY LIKE FEW BIKERS HAVE… FROZEN!

Racers on the NICE LIST will enjoy the fun and challenging course for 2 hours. Those on the NAUGHTY LIST will be punished for 4 grueling hours. Riders who want to work together as a group can sign up for the REINDEER TEAM OPTION: teams of 2 or more will send out one rider on course, at a time, while the others stay warm and cozy by the outside fire pit or in their warming house.

events.title: Santa Fun Run
events.description:
Bring your holiday cheer to Reynolds on December 6th for the 11th Annual Santa Fun Run! The Sidney Run Club is teaming up with Reynolds and High Caliber Sports for another festive fun run during the annual Christmas Classic! There will be both a 5k course as well as a 1 mile route for families!

Run as Santa himself, one of his many Elves, or maybe in an ugly sweater! The real Santa and Mrs. Claus will be there to kick off the run!

A portion of the proceeds from the run benefit the local Christmas Coalition. The Richland County Christmas Coalition "Gifts from the Heart" event is an annual gift distribution to those in need in the community. Recipients are allowed to choose gifts for a child that resides full time in their home and under the age of 18. We have been incredibly grateful to donate over $1000 the last couple years!
